codeVerificationFailure: This code couldn't be verified. Try again or send a new one.

failureStates.message: Couldn't send a code. Check your connection and try again.
failureStates.retainedState: Keep the email; remain on A02-email. Retry uses the same address.

failureStates.message: Couldn't send a code. Try again.
failureStates.retainedState: Keep the email. A server cooldown says: A code can’t be sent yet. Try again shortly.

failureStates.message: Couldn't verify the code. Check your connection and try again.
failureStates.retainedState: Keep the email and all six digits. Do not label the code wrong or expired.

failureStates.message: Couldn't send a new code. Check your connection and try again.
failureStates.retainedState: Keep the address, old challenge and typed digits. Do not reset the wait until a new send is confirmed.

failureStates.message: Couldn't send a new code. Try again.
failureStates.retainedState: Same retained input. Respect a returned server cooldown; do not claim an email was sent.

failureStates.message: Couldn't save your profile. Try again.
failureStates.retainedState: Keep the name and selected photo. For a network failure: Couldn’t save your profile. Check your connection and try again.

failureStates.message: Couldn't upload your profile photo. Try again or continue without a photo.
failureStates.retainedState: Keep the name and selected image. Offer Retry photo upload. Continue still works with the initial fallback.

failureStates.message: Couldn't revoke Alex's invitation link. Try again.
failureStates.retainedState: Keep Alex’s row, prepared link and all other invitation state. Do not show Link revoked.

failureStates.message: Couldn't confirm that Alex's invitation link was revoked. Check your connection and try again.
failureStates.retainedState: Keep the row and last known state. Recheck the token status; the request may have reached the server.

revokeLink.confirmationBody: Alex won't be able to use this link. You can create a new link for Alex later.
revokeLink.knownFailure: Couldn't revoke Alex's invitation link. Try again.
revokeLink.uncertainNetworkFailure: Couldn't confirm that Alex's invitation link was revoked. Check your connection and try again.
revokeLink.scope: Only an unaccepted invitation token is revoked. Do not remove an accepted member or silently change a roster. Hide the revoke action after Accepted.

createInvitation.createFailure: Couldn't create the invitation link for Sam. Try again.
createInvitation.retention: Keep Sam and any prepared link; do not create a second token when returning from a canceled share sheet.

linkEntry.invalid: That doesn't look like a Tadayo invitation link. Check the link and try again.
linkEntry.clipboardEmpty: There isn't an invitation link to paste. Copy the link and try again.
linkEntry.cannotCheck: Couldn't check the invitation link. Check your connection and try again.
linkEntry.retention: Keep the pasted URL and pending invitation through authentication. No club or roster is shown before sign-in.

historyBoundary.display: Days shared after you join a club will appear here after they open.
historyBoundary.enforcement: Per-drop membership interval; exclude pre-join submissions even when they reveal after joining.

approval.body: Leila must accept the exact roster. Every existing member must approve the same roster. Either can happen first.
approval.boundary: Leila will see only drops shared after joining.
approval.privacy: We don't identify who declined. Nobody is asked to give a reason.
